clips.title: The story
paras: Unrequited Love is an Alliance delivery quest originating in Auberdine on the shores of Darkshore. Hollee asks travelers taking the vessel to Menethil Harbor to deliver a personal note to Tarrel Rockweaver, an excavation classmate for whom she still holds quiet affection.

In the port town of Auberdine along the misty coast of Darkshore, Hollee watches travelers boarding ships for the Eastern Kingdoms. She seeks aid from passersby to reach an old classmate, Tarrel Rockweaver, with whom she shared years studying the craft of excavation before graduation separated them across continents.

While Hollee fondly recalls Tarrel's sharp mind and skill with excavation, her composure falters at the mention of his wife, Merrin. Despite the distance and his marriage, Hollee entrusts an adventurer with a personal letter, asking them to seek out Tarrel near Menethil Harbor to ensure he is safe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!
My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.
It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: She always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!
I think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!
